label: Bible Study
prompt: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have _____ the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verse: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
note: Job in the dark, still holding on — God's words mattered more to him than his next meal.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For ye were as sheep going _____; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
verse: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
note: Once wandering sheep, now home with the Shepherd and Bishop of our souls.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal _____ upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verse: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
note: The king set the royal crown on Esther's head — an orphan girl, now queen of Persia.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself _____ from the world.
verse: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
note: James defines religion by orphans, widows and a clean coat — practice over performance.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is _____.
verse: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
note: After wrestling till daybreak, Jacob limped away amazed: he had seen God face to face, and his life was 'preserved.'
